`module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.syncer` targets the syncer Lambda but does not wait for its EventBridge invoke permission. The target can be active before EventBridge is authorized to invoke the function.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
`module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.syncer` can become active before EventBridge has permission to invoke the syncer Lambda; an event arriving in that interval can fail. Wait for the corresponding Lambda permission.

----------------------------------------

EventBridge can invoke the syncer Lambda, but this target has no ordering dependency on the Lambda permission that grants EventBridge invocation access. Ensure the permission exists before registering the target to avoid an invocation failure.
